user.title: WhatsMiner API 3.x
user.description: Direct local connection. Setup reads telemetry only. API 2.x on port 4028 is not supported. Select Submit to continue to API power control and web settings when enabled. The API connection uses TCP port 4433 automatically.

control.title: Power control
control.description: Enter limits appropriate for your exact model. Enable API Write in WhatsminerTool. Use super or user1–user3. Setup does not test credentials with a write command. This is the password for the selected API account, separate from web login credentials. The super account has its own password; do not assume the web admin password matches it. Manage account passwords in WhatsminerTool > Password.

web.title: Individual chip web data
web.description: Chip data uses the built-in LuCI page over HTTPS on port 443. Enter the web login credentials (usually admin); these do not set the API account password. Certificate verification is enabled by default; disable it only for a trusted local miner with a self-signed certificate. Leave the password blank to preserve the stored web password. Chip data is read once per hour by default, independently of the API polling interval. Values and their last successful update time remain unchanged between chip polls.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read API 3.x. Check host, port 4433, firmware and connectivity.
error.different_device: Different miner at this address. Add it as a separate device.
error.web_credentials_required: Enter the web username and password for LuCI login.

init.title: Connection settings
init.description: This is the first settings step. Select Submit to edit API account/password and power limits when power control is enabled, then web authentication when chip data is enabled. Settings are saved only after the final step. The API connection uses TCP port 4433 automatically.

control.title: Power control
control.description: Enter the password for the selected API account (super or user1-user3). These are separate from web login credentials. A blank password keeps the stored value. Select Submit to continue to web settings when enabled; changes are saved only after the final step. Saving does not issue power commands. The super account has its own password; do not assume the web admin password matches it. Manage account passwords in WhatsminerTool > Password.
